processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Ingots with nominal composition Fe-35Mn-19Al-5Cu (at.%) produced by melting raw materials of high purity (>99.9%) in a vacuum induction furnace under an argon atmosphere.
Ingots homogenized at 1200 °C for 24 h before hot rolling.
Homogenized ingots hot-rolled into plates with a thickness of 4 mm.
Plates cut into 10 × 5 × 2 mm³ samples for Vickers hardness measurements and microstructure characterizations.
Samples solution treated at 1100 °C for 10 min under an argon atmosphere, followed by oil quenching. This is the defining process of the current sample (solid-solution/soft state).
Samples for Vickers hardness, XRD, SEM and EBSD prepared by electrolytic polishing using a mixture of 10 % perchloric acid and 90 % ethanol.

structures.overall_structure: Single-phase α (Body-centered cubic, BCC) solid solution; the solution-treated state of the 19Al Fe-Mn-Al-Cu low-density steel.

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: Fine, equiaxed, multi-coloured grain structure; raising Al from 15 to 19 at.% markedly refines the grain structure (EBSD IPF map of solution-treated 19Al, 500 µm scale bar).

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Vickers microhardness; load 9.8 N for 15 s; each sample tested 5 times and averaged

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Load 9.8 N for 15 s; each sample tested 5 times, hardness given as the average of 5 measurements; specimens electrolytically polished (10% perchloric acid + 90% ethanol)
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure Vickers hardness of the solution-treated (and aged) samples
characterization_methods.key_findings: Solution-treated 19Al alloy hardness = 263.8 ± 1.1 HV; the solution-treated hardness increased with rising Al content (attributed to solid-solution strengthening).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: GeminiSEM 300 SEM; scanning step size 1.5 µm (low magnification) and 0.05 µm (high magnification)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Electrolytically polished surfaces (10% perchloric acid + 90% ethanol)
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify constituent phases and grain structure of the solution-treated alloys (Fig. 3)
characterization_methods.key_findings: Single α (BCC) phase in the solution-treated Fe-Mn-Al-Cu steels; the solution-treated 19Al alloy shows a fine, equiaxed, multi-coloured grain structure (phase map uniformly red = α BCC).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: ZEISS Sigma 300 SEM operated at 5 kV; FEI Talos F200X TEM equipped with EDS detector (200 kV)
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure chemical composition of the alloys and micro-areas
characterization_methods.key_findings: EDS-measured chemical composition of the 19Al alloy (at.%): Fe 41.6, Mn 34.8, Al 18.6, Cu 5.0 (Table 1).

characterization_methods.purpose: Measure densities of the 15Al, 17Al and 19Al alloys
characterization_methods.key_findings: Densities of 15Al, 17Al and 19Al alloys = 6.85, 6.76 and 6.66 g·cm⁻³, respectively.

unmapped_findings: Elastic modulus of the 19Al alloy = 181 GPa, measured through compressive stress-strain curves (along with 164 GPa for 15Al and 175 GPa for 17Al); the paper does not specify which heat-treatment state this value corresponds to, and it is used in Eq. (1) for the fracture-toughness evaluation of the peak-hardness samples (b0023).

The solution-treated state is the soft, single-phase α (BCC) parent state from which all aging treatments in the study proceed; the 19Al alloy's solution-treated hardness of 263.8 ± 1.1 HV is the highest of the three alloys' solution-treated values, reflecting increased solid-solution strengthening with rising Al content (b0036).
EDS-measured chemical composition of the 19Al alloy (at.%) from Table 1: Fe 41.6, Mn 34.8, Al 18.6, Cu 5.0 (b0013). This corresponds to the alloy composition of the examined solution-treated sample.
